extracted.intended_audience: general public, media, and stakeholders seeking official communications from the Office of the Texas Governor
extracted.subtask_description: A government web page that lists the Office of the Texas Governor's public communications (press releases, proclamations, appointments, etc.). It is a publication/publishing interface for official announcements rather than a how-to guide for writing press releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Categories
rubrics_metrics.description: News Categories: Press Release; Appointment; Proclamation; Legislative Statement; News Archive; Legislative Action; 89-R; All Bills Signed by Governor; All Bills Filed Without Signature by Governor; All Bills Vetoed by Governor; Veto Statements; 89-CS2; Legislature Online Bill Search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Items are organized and published under explicit categories. When publishing or classifying a communication on this site, select the appropriate category (e.g., 'Press Release', 'Proclamation', 'Appointment', etc.) so it appears in the corresponding listing and archive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Featured designation
rubrics_metrics.description: Some items are labeled 'Featured' (e.g., 'Texas Opens Applications For Texas Education Freedom Accounts' is marked Featured).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certain items can be flagged as Featured to give them prominence in the listing. Use the featured flag to highlight high-priority or high-visibility announcements.
